prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1142; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with radiation into the right trapezius region, along with low back pain and muscle stiffness on waking. Physical examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and no focal neurological deficits. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation based on clinical findings.

Treatment over the course of eight visits included manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, guided therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Pain was managed with over-the-counter analgesics and intermittent ice application. The patient's symptoms improved steadily across visits, with neck range of motion nearing functional limits and pain levels reduced by approximately half from initial presentation.

At the most recent visit the patient reported residual intermittent stiffness with prolonged sitting and driving. Prognosis is good. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
